Body.Content:
What and Why:

We are introducing the ability to pop out Copilot Chat into a separate floating window in Outlook for Mac and iPad. This enhancement gives users greater flexibility when working with Copilot Chat alongside Outlook, making it easier to switch contexts, manage email, and access Outlook controls while keeping Copilot Chat visible.

Rollout Schedule:

  • General Availability (Worldwide): Rollout begins in mid-August 2026 and is expected to complete by mid-September 2026.

Impact on Your Organization:

Who is affected:

  • Users with access to Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac and Outlook for iPad.

Platforms:

  • Outlook for Mac, Outlook for iPad.

After this rollout:

  • Users can select the Pop out button in Copilot Chat to open the chat in a separate window that floats over the main Outlook window.
  • On Mac, users can drag and resize the Copilot Chat window within the boundaries of the Outlook application window.
  • On iPad, users can reposition Copilot Chat horizontally and resize it vertically.
  • A Return button allows users to move Copilot Chat back into the main Outlook window.
  • A Close button allows users to close the Copilot Chat window.
  • This feature is enabled by default for eligible users.

Action Required/Recommendations:

No action is required. You may want to notify your users about this updated Copilot Chat experience and update any internal training or documentation as appropriate.

Compliance Considerations:

No compliance considerations identified, review as appropriate for your organization.

Details.Name: Summary
Details.Value: Copilot Chat in Outlook for Mac and iPad can now pop out into a separate floating window, allowing easier multitasking. This feature, enabled by default, rolls out worldwide from mid-August to mid-September 2026. Users can resize, reposition, return, or close the chat window with no action required from organizations.

Title: Copilot Chat can float over your Outlook iPad and Mac window
